title: Love Your Neighbor as Yourself
reflectionText: This is not a vague call to be nice. Loving your neighbor here looks like leaving grain in the field for the poor, paying a worker before nightfall, judging fairly, refusing to slander, and reproving a brother honestly instead of hating him. Five times the same refrain lands: I am Yahweh. The command is grounded not in sentiment but in who God is. Which of these very specific loves is the one you would rather keep vague?
